name: Busyness by club and hour
description: Spec §14.6: door net, check-ins and staff crowd rating by Bangkok hour.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: Busyness by hour
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, hour, door_net, checkins, crowd_rating_avg from analytics.busyness_by_hour where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, hour, door_net, checkins, crowd_rating_avg from analytics_demo.busyness_by_hour where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date, (hour + 12) % 24
